title: What cabarets played: singers and ragtime
summary: Cafes always had singers and played what was then called ragtime; Bosdorfer played Maple Leaf Rag wonderfully.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I never have known what kind of numbers they played in cabarets.

Well they played all the singing, you know, they used to always have singers in the cafes, and of course they played jazz too, I say jazz, that's what they call it now, but ragtime they used to call it in those days. When you played jazz they'd call it, well it plays ragtime, you see. Well would you play, say, Maple Leaf Rag? Yeah, Maple Leaf Rag, and Weisdorf used to play that wonderfully.
Did you play any other rags by Joplin or James Scott or?
